notes: mode: off | proxy | wireguard | system. In 'proxy' mode the browser routes through 'proxy' (e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:9050). 'endpoints' is your BYO exit list [{name, region, proxy}] shown in Settings > Network to choose from or auto-optimize (lowest latency). Recognition operates no exit servers. Routing changes apply on next launch. exit_check_url is used only when you click Verify. wireguard tunnels are managed by scripts/recognition_vpn_wireguard_v1.ps1.
